topic: Material identity under constant lighting: beyond color-only CMF
reference_model: glTF 2.0 metallic-roughness categories (base color / metallic / roughness / normal / occlusion)
truth_boundary: Representational calibration only; not a PBR renderer, not measured reflectance, not a construction/material approval.
v1_failure: Material identity carried mostly by hue and labels; same highlight width, texture scale and edge response made three materials feel like colored gray-model surfaces.
v2_failure: Response channels separated, but surface patterns became too decorative and periodic, creating pattern identity instead of material identity.
v3_repairs: replace decorative rust dots with non-periodic surface variation
v3_verification: Local rendered PNG and grayscale derivative were reopened. Material families remain distinguishable before reading captions; this proves training-level visual separation only.
